tasks.title: Essay: Reducing waste at public events
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

In your English class you have been talking about how to reduce waste at public events such as concerts or sports matches. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most effective way to reduce waste at public events?

Notes

Write about:

1. reusable food containers
2. clear sorting stations
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: An environmentally responsible event
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted

Have you recently attended an event that made a real effort to be environmentally responsible? It could be a festival, a sports event, a market or something similar.

Write a review for our magazine. Describe one specific environmental action the organisers took, explain how it affected your experience as a visitor, and say whether you would recommend this event to others.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Low-waste habits for young adults
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement on a lifestyle website for young adults.

Articles wanted

Low-waste habits that actually work

We are collecting practical, realistic low-waste habits that young people can fit into their daily lives.

Write an article for our website. Describe one shopping choice and one food or packaging habit that help reduce waste, and explain how you manage to keep them up consistently.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Helping organise a school event with a waste-reduction target
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You have received this email from your classmate, Sam, who is helping to organise a multi-school event.

From: Sam
Subject: Help with our event's waste target

Hi,
Our event has a target to reduce waste by 30% compared to last year. I'm responsible for coordinating volunteers and I need help. Could you take on a specific responsibility? Also, what two waste-reduction measures would you recommend for the event? I'd like to know why you think they'd work. Finally, do you have any questions about the suppliers we're using?

Thanks,
Sam

Write your email.
